nqueens.optimizer: SGD momentum0.5 cosine lr30, zero initialization, per-offset gradient preconditioning, no L1
nqueens.search: 20 chains, local-margin stop, temperature1.0 times unit, cap20000; first chain N1, lowest-energy chain N20
nqueens.temperature_unit: Training-row-weighted mean of absolute two-state field difference over all cells in solution boards.
nqueens.delta: Minimum alternative-state field minus true-state field over all cells of all training solutions.
nqueens.fit_timing: Index route produces scored model; dense map timed separately; each fresh process includes cold+7warm fits; paper timing is seed0 warm median.

graph_coloring.energy: full: every pair reads all adjacency tokens, unrestricted3x3 affine cost
graph_coloring.optimizer: SGD momentum0.5 cosine lr10, zero initialization, proximalL1
graph_coloring.search: CPU focused search,20chains, term-max stopping,temperature2/3 timeshbar,theta0.45,cap10000
graph_coloring.fit_timing: one cold+7warm fits for each CPU and GPU model; CPU model used for test, as official code

metrics: Table3 metrics recomputed from saved chains with no new model inference. Diagnostic upstream checkpoint metrics use different N20/coverage definitions and are kept separate.
hand_controls: Official hand energies, validation-only temperature selection, test seeds0,1,2; each test evaluation once.
neural_baselines: Confirmed scope: published baseline values may be imported and labeled; neural baseline retraining is excluded.
